Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #737.

Cards.Name: An End to Hostilities
Cards.Text: Limited: Until the game ends, each player draws two cards instead of one at the end of his turn if he put no other cards in his hand that turn.

Cards.Name: Unseasonable Weather
Cards.Text: Until your next turn begins, after each time a Personality is assigned to attack, negate his straightening during his controller's next Straighten Phase (after he assigns).
